text.name: tpab_settings_action_msgs_label
text.text: Action messages

text.name: tpab_settings_action_msgs_tooltip
text.text: Show on-screen confirmations when you send, recall, or cancel a herd. Curfew announcements and errors are always shown.

text.name: tpab_settings_dusk_reminder_label
text.text: Dusk reminder

text.name: tpab_settings_dusk_reminder_tooltip
text.text: Notify at %s game time if any herd is still on pasture. The %s curfew still applies to any herds still out at that time.

text.text: Message size

text.name: tpab_settings_msg_size_tooltip

text.text: Color of on-screen notification messages from To Pasture and Back.

text.text: Message position

text.name: tpab_settings_msg_position_lower
text.text: Lower third

text.name: tpab_settings_msg_bg_label
text.text: Message background

text.name: tpab_settings_msg_bg_tooltip
text.text: Draws a box behind the messages for readability. Pair a light text color with a dark background.

text.name: tpab_settings_msg_bg_dark

text.name: tpab_settings_msg_bg_opaque

text.name: tpab_settings_warn_style_label
text.text: Warning style

text.name: tpab_settings_warn_style_tooltip
text.text: How refusals are shown, such as the note when you try to collect a herd too far from a barn. Same as messages: your message size, color, background and position. FS25 default: the game's own warning display, which your message settings do not change.

text.name: tpab_settings_warn_style_same
text.text: Same as messages

text.name: tpab_settings_warn_style_game
text.text: FS25 default

text.name: tpab_settings_curfew_label
text.text: Curfew at %s

text.name: tpab_settings_curfew_tooltip
text.text: When enabled, all animals still out on pasture are automatically recalled at %s game time. A safety net for forgotten herds.

text.name: tpab_curfew_recall_msg
text.text: The herdsman has returned all animals from pasture for the night.

text.name: tpab_settings_fences_label
text.text: Show pasture fences

text.name: tpab_settings_fences_tooltip
text.text: Show temporary fences around pasture areas. Visual only, does not affect the herds. Skipped automatically when the area already has its own fence.

text.name: tpab_settings_poultry_label
text.text: Poultry shown

text.name: tpab_settings_poultry_tooltip
text.text: How many birds a coop shows. "Same as herd animals" follows Realistic Livestock RM's visible animals setting, and a number above that setting shows Realistic Livestock RM's number. Showing fewer birds changes nothing else: the coop keeps all its animals.

text.name: tpab_settings_poultry_same
text.text: Same as herd animals
